# Assumption of Moses Chapter 6 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Wicked Kings and Roman Rule

---

**6:1** Then powerful kings will arise over them and will be called the priests of the Most High God.

**6:2** They will commit great iniquity in the holy of holies.

**6:3** And then an insolent king will rise up who will not be of a priestly family, a reckless and wicked man.

**6:4** He will judge them as they deserve.

**6:5** He will burn their city, smash the altars, and carry off silver and gold.

**6:6** He will drive out those who are in it, and will have captives and take them with him.

**6:7** He will put aged men and young men to death, and will not spare them.

**6:8** Then will come upon them the fear and trembling of this king.

**6:9** And he will take them captive as plunder.

**6:10** He will ravage their land for thirty-four years.

**6:11** He will punish them and afflict them.

**6:12** And that man will be carried off to Egypt, and he will die there.

**6:13** For the Lord will punish him with the punishment of captivity.

**6:14** And after him another king will arise like himself, his son, who shall reign for a short time.

**6:15** He will afflict their people with every kind of grievous punishment.

**6:16** And he will rule over them for thirty-four years.

**6:17** In his days his sons will quarrel, and all will be corrupt.

**6:18** And there will come against them a mighty king of the kings of the earth who will rule over them.

**6:19** He will crucify those who confess their circumcision.

**6:20** He will torture those who deny it and compel them to abandon their holy law.

**6:21** He will torture wise men among them and will make them speak evil of themselves.
